declared_purpose: Provide persistent agent memory, semantic recall, knowledge graphs and decay, with defenses against prompt injection, credential leakage and poisoning. Optional conversation capture and Cloud sync support that purpose; particular capture scopes, logging fields and repair defaults are implementation choices (SKILL.md:3–4,80–82,168–179).

data_operations.operation: Read configuration and resolve local components
data_operations.source: ShieldCortex config, OpenClaw plugin configuration, installed binaries and package files
data_operations.data_scope: Configuration including cloudApiKey, consent flags, binary paths and installation metadata; parsed configuration remains in gateway memory.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local hook/plugin runtime
data_operations.condition: Runtime initialization and configuration checks; ShieldCortex configuration is refreshed when its modification time changes.

data_operations.operation: Read session transcripts locally
data_operations.source: Session JSONL file supplied by the OpenClaw event
data_operations.data_scope: Entire file is read before selecting its last 30 lines. User and assistant text is collected; only assistant-authored text reaches session extraction.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Hook process memory
data_operations.condition: Registered /new or /stop event, openclawAutoMemory=true and a session file path. Reading occurs before checking extractor availability.

data_operations.operation: Extract and request storage of session memories
data_operations.source: Recent assistant transcript text
data_operations.data_scope: Extractor-generated title, content, category and memoryPurpose; project=openclaw, scope=global, normal importance, provenance tags and workspaceDir. Categories and purposes are inferred attributes.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local ShieldCortex remember tool through mcporter; entry declares persistence in ~/.shieldcortex/memories.db shared across integrations.
data_operations.condition: Auto-memory enabled, local extractor resolves, candidates exist, novelty permits them and any available candidate screen accepts them. Missing candidate-screen export permits unscreened candidates to proceed to remember.

data_operations.operation: Scan live input locally
data_operations.source: OpenClaw llm_input event
data_operations.data_scope: event.prompt plus the last five user text blocks extracted from history; internal-pattern matches and texts shorter than ten characters are skipped.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local ShieldCortex scan_tool_response tool, in advisory mode; parsed verdict returns to the plugin.
data_operations.condition: Realtime plugin installed and enabled; manifest disables it by default. This scan does not require auto-memory or Cloud sync.

data_operations.operation: Infer memories from live assistant output
data_operations.source: event.assistantTexts
data_operations.data_scope: Pattern-inferred architecture, error, learning, preference or note category; title from the first 80 characters and content from the first 500 characters of matching text. Includes sessionId, agentId, workspaceDir, provenance and global scope.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local ShieldCortex remember tool
data_operations.condition: Realtime plugin active, openclawAutoMemory=true, eligible output matches a pattern and passes novelty filtering. Up to three candidates; recognized tool-result text is excluded.

data_operations.operation: Transfer tool arguments to local subprocesses
data_operations.source: Hook/plugin scan, remember and recall calls
data_operations.data_scope: JSON arguments containing relevant raw text, titles, queries and contextual metadata appear in subprocess argv.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: npx mcporter process and its ShieldCortex stdio server; stdout normally returns only to the caller.
data_operations.condition: callCortex invocation. Uses execFile with an argv array rather than a shell.

data_operations.operation: Inspect memory-write tool calls and retain temporary denial fingerprints
data_operations.source: remember and mcp__memory__remember title/content arguments
data_operations.data_scope: Local directive checks, imported defense-pipeline classifications and deterministic normalized-content hashes. Denial cache defaults to 200 entries per tool with two-hour validity.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local interceptor and dynamically imported shieldcortex/defence; denial cache stays in process memory.
data_operations.condition: Plugin interceptor initializes successfully and a watched tool receives nonempty text. Inline directive failures block immediately; ordinary pipeline verdicts follow severityActions, whose defaults log or warn. Session-end cleanup clears the cache when supported.

data_operations.operation: Display content during conditional approval
data_operations.source: Intercepted memory title and content
data_operations.data_scope: Up to 200 characters, tool name, inferred severity and threat indicators.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Host-provided context.requireApproval interface; its downstream handling is unspecified.
data_operations.condition: Interceptor component receives require_approval configuration and the host supplies the callback. Bundled registration normalizes away interceptor configuration, so this branch is not established as reachable through that registration.

data_operations.operation: Append local audit records
data_operations.source: Flagged input scans, memory extraction summaries and intercepted memory writes
data_operations.data_scope: Flagged input previews up to 100 characters with session/model metadata; intercepted title/content previews up to 200 characters with verdicts and outcomes, including blocked or denied attempts; successful extraction counts.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: ~/.shieldcortex/audit/realtime-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl
data_operations.condition: Relevant event occurs. Interceptor logging includes ordinary log/warn outcomes. Supplied appenders contain no preview redaction or retention cleanup.

data_operations.operation: Emit rejected candidate titles to diagnostics
data_operations.source: Session memory candidates refused by the optional candidate screen
data_operations.data_scope: Candidate title and matched pattern names; full candidate content is omitted.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Gateway console; persistence or forwarding of console output is unknown.
data_operations.condition: Candidate screen exists and returns refusal patterns.

data_operations.operation: Persist deduplication fingerprints and descriptive fields
data_operations.source: Auto-memory candidates following a truthy remember response
data_operations.data_scope: Normalized-content hash, up to 200 deterministic token/bigram hashes, plaintext title up to 120 characters, category and creation timestamp. Default count limit is 300, configurable from 50 to 1000.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: ~/.shieldcortex/openclaw-memory-cache.json, shared by hook and plugin
data_operations.condition: Dedupe is enabled and a fingerprint is generated. Code tests response truthiness rather than parsing an accepted-storage verdict. Count pruning is implemented; time-based expiry is not shown.

data_operations.operation: Read installed hooks and surface scan warnings
data_operations.source: ~/.openclaw/hooks immediate child directories
data_operations.data_scope: HOOK.md and handler.js contents, excluding cortex-memory and internal directories; resulting unsafe hook names.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local scan_skill tool; warning names enter OpenClaw bootstrapFiles context.
data_operations.condition: agent:bootstrap with bootstrapFiles available. Warning Markdown is added as context, without an observed Markdown file write.

data_operations.operation: Read memory directly for an optional bootstrap pack and persist session state
data_operations.source: Configured memories.db, inject configuration and previous session-state JSON
data_operations.data_scope: Helper-selected memory rows, helper-built context and sessionState; sanitized session identifier appears in the state filename.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: OpenClaw bootstrapFiles context and <config directory>/state/inject-oc-<session>.json
data_operations.condition: External inject helper resolves, nativeContract is set, mode is neither off nor turn, and database exists. Database opens read-only; state is written before checking whether pack text will be injected.

data_operations.operation: Implement dormant keyword capture and proactive recall
data_operations.source: Compatible user-message events or command fallback text
data_operations.data_scope: Substring-inferred save intent/category; text after a trigger or the whole short-context message. Recall uses the first 200 message characters, project=*, limit=5; framed results can enter event.messages.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local remember/recall tools, novelty cache and host event messages
data_operations.condition: Dormant under the supplied manifest: no message subscription or other command subscription. Message paths additionally require top-level role/content absent from the documented core event shape. Proactive recall separately requires proactiveRecall=true.

data_operations.operation: Transmit realtime threat and interception metadata
data_operations.source: Flagged llm_input entries and interceptor audit entries
data_operations.data_scope: Input events retain sessionId, model, reason, hook/type and timestamp after removing content/preview. Interceptor events retain tool, severity, verdict, threats, anomaly score, action, outcome and timestamp after removing preview. cloudApiKey authenticates requests.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: <cloudBaseUrl>/v1/threats and <cloudBaseUrl>/v1/audit/ingest; default base https://api.shieldcortex.ai
data_operations.condition: Sender requires cloudEnabled and cloudApiKey. Input forwarding loads configuration per event; interceptor forwarding uses configuration captured at first initialization and can continue after a later opt-out.

data_operations.operation: Declare core memory, quarantine and provenance persistence
data_operations.source: Manual and automatically extracted memory writes; memory read/write/delete activity
data_operations.data_scope: Verbatim titles/content in SQLite, quarantined flagged content, defense audit records and provenance content hashes. A quarantine outcome is persistence outside live memory, rather than deletion.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: ~/.shieldcortex/memories.db and associated local audit/quarantine stores
data_operations.condition: Entry declares defense filtering before writes, live storage for allowed content and blocked/quarantined outcomes otherwise. Memories persist across sessions until removal or pruning. Core implementation is absent.

data_operations.operation: Declare additional local scans and display surfaces
data_operations.source: Agent memory/rules files, MCP configurations and .env files
data_operations.data_scope: Local file contents for security analysis; dashboard memory rows with RESTRICTED content withheld and credential patterns in titles/metadata masked.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local scanner and localhost API/dashboard/WebSocket/browser
data_operations.condition: Explicit scans/audit or dashboard use. Entry declares loopback defaults; non-loopback API binding requires an explicit flag and SHIELDCORTEX_API_TOKEN. Implementations are absent.

data_operations.operation: Declare optional core Cloud uploads
data_operations.source: Security scan metadata, stored memories, embeddings, graph records and quarantine
data_operations.data_scope: Audit scores, indicators, categories, timings and device name; PUBLIC/INTERNAL memory titles/content with embeddings/metadata and graph entities/relationships; quarantine content with detected credentials redacted.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: https://api.shieldcortex.ai, including /v1/audit/ingest and /v1/sync/memories
data_operations.condition: Cloud explicitly enabled with an API key. Full memory/graph sync requires Enterprise or grandfathered Team access; CONFIDENTIAL/RESTRICTED memories excluded by default and metadata-only mode offered. Quarantine sync is Enterprise. Actual selection, redaction and remote retention are unresolved.

data_operations.operation: Declare model/package downloads and explicit remote lookups
data_operations.source: Model identifiers, package identifiers and user-supplied env-scan URLs
data_operations.data_scope: Download/lookup requests; X-Ray package name in request URL; downloaded model/package artifacts. No memory-content upload is declared for these paths.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: huggingface.co; registry.npmjs.org; metadata-selected deep X-Ray tarball host; supplied env-scan URL. Models cache under ~/.cache/shieldcortex/models.
data_operations.condition: Uncached embedding model downloads at startup/first embedding operation, with one corruption retry, unless SHIELDCORTEX_SKIP_EMBEDDINGS=1. Explainer download requires explicit consent. Updates/X-Ray/env scans are explicit. Missing local server can invoke npx -y shieldcortex on a tool call.

data_operations.operation: Declare license validation and configured webhook disclosure
data_operations.source: Activated license and memory/operator/maintenance events
data_operations.data_scope: Subscription identifier for license validation; memory-event payloads of unspecified shape; action-guard hold/deny notifications and maintenance_fail check names.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: https://api.shieldcortex.ai for license activation; user-configured webhook URLs for event POSTs
data_operations.condition: License activation, including with Cloud disabled; webhooks only after configuration. No periodic license recheck is declared. Implementations and webhook field selection are absent.

data_operations.operation: Declare installation/configuration persistence and legacy migration
data_operations.source: Existing integration configuration, legacy memory/config directories and packaged integration files
data_operations.data_scope: MCP/hook registration, copied integration files, seeded defaults and moved or removed legacy memory/config data.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: ~/.shieldcortex/, integration config files and OpenClaw hook/plugin locations
data_operations.condition: User-run setup/install; fresh global non-CI installation may seed openclawAutoMemory=true and proactiveRecall=true. Existing config is retained. Named-host setup can wire without asking.

data_operations.operation: Read, copy and delete hook files during automatic self-heal
data_operations.source: Running hook files, installed package copies and two legacy hook directories
data_operations.data_scope: HOOK.md, handler.ts and runtime.mjs; local installation paths in logs/bootstrap notices.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Canonical ~/.openclaw/hooks/internal/cortex-memory/; recursive deletion of ~/.clawdbot/hooks/cortex-memory and ~/.clawdbot/hooks/internal/cortex-memory without backup
data_operations.condition: First bootstrap per gateway process. Mutations default on unless selfHeal=false or SHIELDCORTEX_SKIP_SELF_HEAL=1. Expected-location branch removes legacy copies when ~/.clawdbot is not a symlink and reads package files for staleness; unexpected-location branch copies the hook.

data_operations.operation: Declare memory deletion and pruning
data_operations.source: Stored memories and malformed-memory selections
data_operations.data_scope: Individual or filtered memory records; source-wide revocation; low-value entries; malformed-memory deletion with a backup.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local memory database, deletion audit ledger and malformed-purge backup
data_operations.condition: forget is declared own-only and audited; source revocation additionally requires out-of-band enablement, hierarchy checks and a row cap. Decay/consolidation may prune. Implementations and cleanup of secondary copies are absent.

potential_excess.data_scope: Full transcript history and collected user-message strings beyond assistant extraction input
potential_excess.condition: Auto-memory session extraction with an available transcript.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Recent assistant context is needed for optional extraction; reading all history is an implementation choice. This is extra data in a required read.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Extract from eligible assistant text in the last 30 transcript records.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Read only the last 30 complete JSONL records and avoid constructing retained user-message strings.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve record ordering, assistant-role filtering, command exclusion and current text-block selection.

potential_excess.data_scope: Transcript content read when no local extractor can resolve
potential_excess.condition: Auto-memory enabled but loadOpenClawExtract returns null after the transcript has already been read.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: No extraction or save can occur on this path; the entire transcript read is redundant.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Skip capture when the required local extractor is unavailable.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Resolve the extractor before opening the transcript.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep the existing skip notice and successful extraction behavior.

potential_excess.data_scope: Unrelated text in the first 500 characters of pattern-matching assistant output, and its first-80-character title
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Local remember request and declared persistent memory database
potential_excess.condition: Realtime auto-memory enabled; a qualifying pattern can occur anywhere in a longer output block.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Capturing decisions, fixes and preferences requires the relevant fact, not an arbitrary prefix. This is extra data in a required save.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Retain the matched durable fact with enough context to remain useful.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Extract the matching segment with bounded surrounding context and derive its title from that segment.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve meaningful context, category inference, candidate limits, deduplication and defense checks.

potential_excess.data_scope: Plaintext memory titles, categories and creation timestamps duplicated beside fingerprints
potential_excess.condition: Novelty cache updated after a truthy remember reply.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Dedupe comparisons use content hashes and token hashes; descriptive fields are additional persistent data.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Suppress exact and near duplicates across capture paths and restarts.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Persist only the fingerprints and ordering needed for count-bounded deduplication.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep both components compatible and retain current similarity thresholds and cache limits.

potential_excess.data_scope: Unredacted input and memory previews, including rejected content
potential_excess.condition: Flagged input or any audited interceptor outcome, including ordinary logging and blocked writes.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Security auditing requires verdicts and provenance; raw previews are optional diagnostic detail and create another content store outside live-memory filtering.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Record threat classifications, decisions, timestamps and sufficient correlation evidence.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Omit previews by default; use content fingerprints and explicitly enabled, credential-redacted previews with bounded retention.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain auditable outcomes and an operator-controlled route for necessary forensic detail.

potential_excess.condition: Optional candidate screen refuses an automatically extracted memory.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Explaining refusal needs pattern identifiers; reproducing the rejected title adds content to diagnostics.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Omit the title or replace it with a correlation fingerprint.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep pattern names and aggregate refusal reporting.

potential_excess.data_scope: Interceptor event metadata and authentication using the initially captured cloudApiKey
potential_excess.condition: Cloud was enabled at interceptor initialization and is subsequently disabled or reconfigured without restarting the plugin.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Cloud telemetry is explicitly optional. Initial consent is retained in a closure instead of checking current consent, allowing redundant disclosure after opt-out.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Forward metadata only while current Cloud configuration authorizes it.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Reload current configuration for each interception event before invoking syncInterceptEvent.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep metadata-only payloads, current endpoint/credential selection and nonblocking failure handling.

unknowns: All nine supplied files were assessed. Core MCP server, CLI, setup/postinstall, API/dashboard, worker and core Cloud implementations are absent; their declared reads, storage, filtering, transmission and deletion remain unverified.

Dynamically loaded openclaw-extract, inject-pack, recall-frame and shieldcortex/defence implementations are absent. Exact extraction scope, bootstrap candidate selection, ACL enforcement, pack/state contents and defense-pipeline side effects remain unresolved (bundled/cortex-memory-hook/runtime.mjs:134–167; bundled/cortex-memory-hook/handler.ts:529–646,855–883; bundled/openclaw-plugin/index.js:615–636).

The bundled plugin normalizer omits interceptor despite manifest configuration options. Registration therefore obtains defaults rather than those overrides; default high/critical actions warn/log ordinary pipeline results. End-to-end prevention of unsafe storage depends on the absent memory server (bundled/openclaw-plugin/index.js:188–218,245–255,597–636; bundled/openclaw-plugin/interceptor.js:15–29,255–274).

Truthy remember replies are not parsed as accepted-storage outcomes. Whether quarantined or refused writes produce truthy replies, and consequently populate the novelty cache, is unknown (bundled/cortex-memory-hook/handler.ts:459–477; bundled/openclaw-plugin/index.js:552–564).
Cloud retention, access controls, downstream recipients and deletion behavior are not supplied. The entry's seven-day free audit-retention claim is not implementation evidence (SKILL.md:312–315).

The relationship between quarantine-content uploads and the entry's statement that memory sync is the sole raw-text exception is unclear; actual quarantine redaction and payload selection cannot be checked (SKILL.md:175–179). Imported threatIndicators also lack definitions, so their metadata-only semantics cannot be independently established.

No supplied implementation establishes whether forget, database removal or uninstall also clears novelty fingerprints, audit previews, quarantine, backups, bootstrap state or remote replicas (SKILL.md:104,169; bundled/cortex-memory-hook/HOOK.md:102–108).

mcporter, npx, downloaded packages/models and remote services are external to the supplied source. Their additional logging, network behavior and retention are unknown. Console retention and any host forwarding are also unspecified.
